name: F14#1 co-op half: Captain Nerissa's hosted fight numbers equal solo x the declared scaling row
claim: Co-op half of ACCEPTANCE F14 'Veilfall ... pass C2/C3' for Tidewake to cite: C2's harness is solo, so this proves the two-peer fight is the same fight. Two real peers; the host challenges Captain Nerissa through the production trainer battle and the guest joins in progress. At one participant the foe equals the solo build (trainer_npc.creature_for + enemy/enemy_trainer/member combat layering) exactly. At two, the host's foe equals solo x multiplayer.json by_participants['2'] (attack/defence x1.10, attack_cooldown x0.85; max HP, telegraph, power, moves unchanged), for the creature on the field at the join and for the one sent out after it; the guest sees the same species/level/max HP/moves. Every health drop on either peer's creature over 50 s lies inside the solo rolled_damage range (roll 0..1, quick or charged move, stagger critical allowed) computed from solo attack x row and the creature's own effective_defence(is_best, ability). Setup (disclosed): party grants at L55, guardian_fixture prerequisites (the Veilfall chain up to Nerissa), win_trainer_battle's enemy_hp_ceiling 20 to end rounds after the samples. Not claimed: C2's masher/reader outcome rates (statistical, solo harness) or C3 framing.
